description: This file defines a custom Gradle task named `FlutterAnalyzeTask` that runs Flutter's static analysis (`flutter analyze`) from the project root. It is used to facilitate code quality checks within CI pipelines or manual invocations, specifically for a Flutter project integrated with Gradle.
external_methods: cd ../ && flutter pub get && flutter analyze

classes.name: FlutterAnalyzeTask
classes.description: A custom Gradle task extending DefaultTask that executes Flutter's analyze command asynchronously and handles errors.

methods.name: runAnalyze
methods.description: The main action method annotated with @TaskAction, which runs the Flutter analyze command and handles its process output and exit code.
